## Teaching points

1. Plantar bruising after axial loading of a plantarflexed foot warrants assessment for a Lisfranc injury. Displacement requires urgent orthopedic review.
2. Plantar ecchymosis and midfoot pain after a loaded plantarflexed injury are important clues.
3. Protect an unstable midfoot and obtain urgent orthopedic review; do not insist on painful weight-bearing films when displacement is already demonstrated.
4. Imaging and analgesia do not restore joint stability. Recheck neurovascular status while awaiting definitive treatment.
